column1: # control-evidence-map.tsv — the SOURCE OF TRUTH for every control figure the evidence collector
# reports. Tab-separated. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the evidence manifest previously stated control coverage as literals baked
# into the document template ("14 of 14 controls documented"), so there was no input that could make
# it print anything else. An evidence package that collected nothing still asserted complete control
# documentation. Numbers in a document handed to an auditor must be derived from the evidence in the
# package, and a number nobody can change by changing the evidence is not derived from anything.
#   2  ControlId           the control/criterion/article identifier as the published checklist writes it
#   3  EvidenceCategories  comma-separated evidence categories that substantiate this control INSIDE a
# `none` is not a gap in this file — it is a statement that the control's evidence is NOT a CI artifact
# this collector gathers. Those controls are substantiated by documentation, configuration, or a
# business process outside the pipeline. They are counted in ControlsInScope and can NEVER count toward
# ControlsDocumented, whatever is in the package. That asymmetry is deliberate: it is what stops a full
# artifact download from being reported as total control coverage.
# A control is reported as documented only when EVERY category on its row has at least one collected
# file. All-not-any: a control needing both a test result and a scan is not substantiated by one of them.
# Valid categories are exactly the evidence directories the collector creates:
# An unrecognised category makes the collector REFUSE rather than silently score the row as unmet.
# EDITING THIS FILE CHANGES THE REPORTED NUMBERS. That is the point. Each row is transcribed from the
# published certification checklists and from the per-control evidence locations the generated package
# README states; keep it in step with them. Adding a control raises ControlsInScope; mapping one to a
# category that is genuinely collected raises ControlsDocumented.
# ── FedRAMP — NIST 800-53 Rev 5, the 14 controls the published checklist enumerates ────────────────
# ── GDPR — the articles the published checklist enumerates ─────────────────────────────────────────
# ── SOC 2 — Trust Services Criteria the published checklist enumerates ─────────────────────────────
# ── HIPAA — Technical Safeguards, the implementation specifications the checklist enumerates ───────
